body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: d7fe7436c215e6b88c1b6be9481984fd3307e5c5 -->
**No blockers - needs a maintainer look** (process file: `xtask/src/plan.rs` + `PROCESS_VERSION` 12 -> 13). Reviewed inline.

- **Split is faithful.** `docs_steps()` keeps the old setup and step law unchanged. The pixel compare moves to `docs_images_snapshot_match_the_rendered_steps`, which is `#[ignore]`d with its lane named (#255). Its name carries `snapshot`, so the new `--ignored snapshot` filter reaches it. PNGs are untouched, as the snapshot rule requires.
- **Default-suite twin.** `docs_example_steps_through_operations` checks the example opens and that every step from 1..n draws toolpath lines. It is weaker than a pixel compare, but text-only and OS-independent, which is what #255 asks for.
- **Release plan.** The new step 14, `--test gpu_render --ignored snapshot`, is needed because step 13 is `--lib` only. The xtask test pins its exact line and the new count.
- **Version bump.** `PROCESS_VERSION` 12 -> 13 matches upstream main (12). The merger posts on #681.
- **Checks.** `cargo test -p xtask` gives 30 passed on d7fe7436 (local, private target). I didn't build the ui binary here; the author reports `docs_example_steps_through_operations` green on Linux and macOS.
- **Nit.** There is a double blank line after the moved block in `gpu_render.rs`.

For the cut: the ignored compare drifts on macOS too, so the goldens are stale and get regenerated at the cut after a human look.
